meta.title: Ondra memory humanlike
meta.description: Three ways of coming to mind over three channel views: fixed daily recall that favours the faintest memories, cue-driven recall behind a probability gate that reinforces on a hit, and idle association rippling one to three rings out from a single memory. Strength comes only from the memory core, diffusion only from the graph, and cue candidates from the caller, so retrieval is never rebuilt and results are never trimmed by count.
